name: Upcoming contracts to be awarded (CAP)
description: This dataset lists upcoming housing and development contracts that are scheduled to be awarded, with 25 sampled rows and 10 columns. Each row describes a planned project, including its name, borough, geographic district, and a short description. It also records the project's budget range, design completion date, category, and current status, along with physical details such as square footage and seat count. The data can be used to track the pipeline of public development projects, compare planned budgets and timelines across boroughs and districts, and identify projects by type or size. It is useful for planners, contractors, researchers, and community groups interested in where and when future development contracts are expected.
